INSPECT, not selected: gzip-conversation plus cloud-session startup plus API TTFT improvement is an X/changelog-level observation from the official account with a confirmed dated changelog culture, but the causal performance claim is not an independent benchmark. INSPECT, not selected: single-vendor EU adoption report (Enterprise Codex/Work above 50% output tokens in EU sample; 8x weeklies since May; 22% Slovenia to 85% Lithuania spread; frontier 4x typical EU but trails global frontier 2x+) with a sample restricted to Enterprise/Business customers — selection-bias caveat kills lead status. INSPECT, not selected: Fish Audio Drama 3 tech report (arXiv 2610.18010v2, Oct 14 in-window; 35B MoE/3B active, codebook-MTP decoder, 271 fps H200, AA Elo 1244 open-weights #1, $15/1M chars) is a real audio signal with weights on GitHub plus HF, but the lane is too thin for a standalone W42 section — insufficient body on usability, licensing, and independent evaluation. Corroborating audio mention at most; do not conflate a traced report with a deployed-product story.

INSPECT, not selected: Mistral Le Chonk grounding (Large 4 page Oct 6 background: 1T/49-52B MoE, Dense200 42% versus Astra 41% one-point vendor lead) with the Oct 12 X post as feature-highlight only; weights NOT yet open against an end-month promise; independent dispersion is sobering (aggregate index 32nd of 44) and the 1pp lead is unreplicated. Vendor/press-level only pending weights and methods.
